current_answer: Choose a skill by task and platform. Frontend App Builder is a conditional concept-and-render path for a new visual target; Frontend Testing & Debugging is a conditional QA route for a known screen and expected state. OpenAI Game UI Frontend is for browser-game HUDs or menus where playfield visibility and camera or input boundaries matter. Its mobile rules refer to a mobile browser viewport, not a native-app workflow. For an ordinary web-app screen, supply the real route, existing components, a visual reference, and named states before adding a skill. catalogue_card.question: Is a game UI skill right for a mobile app?
catalogue_card.text: Only if it is a browser game. OpenAI Game UI Frontend describes browser-game HUDs, menus, and mobile browser layouts. It is not an established fit for a native mobile app, and we have not tested its result.
